summary: Air-gapped prerequisites: AAP subscription and 2.6 instance, OpenShift project, oc, Helm 3.10+, Podman, internet access on a connected host to registry.redhat.io, a Red Hat pull secret, a way to provide plug-ins (mirror the OCI artifacts image from imageTagInfo or host tarballs), and credentials for the plug-in installer's registry.
